engagement.interaction_backstory: He helped build the Romanian Orthodox parish in his county — literally, with his crew, on weekends, for two years. He found this catalog through a nephew and plays it in the truck with four men in it. It has never occurred to him that a company might want to know that.

depth.core_contradiction: Built a church with his own hands and stands at the back of it every Sunday.
depth.wound: Eighteen years here and he still says he is going home next year.
depth.longing: A house in Romania with somebody living in it.
depth.faith_journey: Orthodox, transported; the parish abroad is more intense than the one at home ever was, because here it is the only Romanian thing there is.
depth.voice_fingerprint: Says little; solves things instead of discussing them; "lasă că mă ocup eu" — leave it, I will handle it.
depth.open_doubt: Whether the house he is building in Vâlcea will ever be more than a building.

social_graph.note: cleans houses; wants to stay; they do not discuss it
four Romanians; the truck is the closest thing to a small group they have

depth.emotional_weather_default: Flat and capable; sentimental at the parish feast day.
depth.daily_texture: Six a.m. sites, Georgia heat, the truck, money sent home monthly, the unfinished house in Vâlcea.
depth.sensory_anchor: Bells at the parish he built, ringing for the first time.
depth.living_arc: The unfinished house is eighteen years old and he has stopped setting a date.
